title: Palpitations
hpi_narrative: A 65-year-old male presents with sudden onset of palpitations. The character is irregular, severity is moderate, associated symptoms are none, pertinent negatives are unknown.

stacks.label: Physical Exam: General Appearance
stacks.finding: General examination is extremely useful to determine how sick the patient looks

stacks.label: Physical Exam: Chest / Lungs
stacks.finding: It is important to investigate for lung pathology which could be contributing to the patient's symptoms

stacks.label: Physical Exam: Heart / Cardiovascular
stacks.finding: The patient is reporting palpitations, so this should be examined

stacks.label: Physical Exam: Extremities / Spine
stacks.finding: With cardiovascular problems, it's important to examine the extremities to look for pathology

stacks.label: CBC with differential
stacks.finding: CBC is always a good screening tool in nearly every patient

stacks.label: Hormone, thyroid stimulating, serum ultrasensitive / Hormone, thyroid stimulating, serum
stacks.finding: Hypothyroidism/hyperthyroidism is associated with arrhythmias. It is important to screen for this condition.

stacks.label: Lipid profile
stacks.finding: This gives you a data point for the patient's risk for heart disease

stacks.label: Serology, lyme disease
stacks.finding: Lyme disease is associated with heart block, so it's important to screen for this condition.

stacks.label: Cardiac troponin |, serum / Cardiac enzymes, serum
stacks.finding: It's important to rule out an myocardial infarction

stacks.label: Sedimentation rate, erythrocyte
stacks.finding: This is to help rule out inflammatory conditions that could cause heart block

stacks.label: Electrocardiography, 12 lead / Electrocardiography, ambulatory / Electrocardiography, rhythm strip, long / Monitor, cardiac / Monitor, cardiac, check
stacks.finding: EKG / Cardiac monitoring would show a third degree heart block
